lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 112, for issue 17, which gives the side pane a Bookmarks section and puts your standard folders in Places.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one twelve, for issue seventeen, which gives the side pane a Bookmarks section and puts your standard folders in Places.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
When Thunar starts, Places lists Computer, Home and Desktop, then Recent and Trash, as before.
New: right after Desktop come Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos, from your user folders file.
New: your bookmarks get their own section with a Bookmarks header, which hides itself when empty.
Devices and Network keep the same entries and simply move down one place.
You can untick any entry from its header's right-click menu, and it stays hidden after a restart.
Dropping, reordering, renaming and removing bookmarks work as before, in the same file.
Before, bookmarks sat right after Trash, so you added a fake divider bookmark that file choosers also show.
The side pane is sorted by group, so two new groups between Trash and Devices make the new section.
Each standard folder shows only if it is set, is a folder, and is not your home or Desktop folder.
The Bookmarks header comes back as soon as the first bookmark is added.
A hidden standard folder is stored apart from a bookmark of it, so hiding one doesn't hide the other.
Here is the new order: Places with the standard folders, then Bookmarks, then Devices and Network.
The folder list is read when Thunar starts, so a change to it shows after a restart.
A bookmarked standard folder shows twice, and each copy hides on its own; old hidden bookmarks no longer hide the Places row.
Three files in the thunar folder change, and a new test script checks the side pane.
To undo it, revert the PR: the bookmarks file and the hidden list keep their format.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
After the reviews, a rebuilt Thunar was tested again in the cloud container, and CI's verify passed; its latest run was still going.
It follows Nemo's layout, Thunar's own section headers, and GLib's list of user folders.
The first commit built and installed, and the smoke test passed in 13 seconds.
lines.say: The first commit built and installed, and the smoke test passed in thirteen seconds.

lines.caption: The new test clicked down the side pane and found the folders and bookmarks in the order the issue asks.
Clicking Downloads, a symlink to another folder, opened it.
Hiding both bookmarks emptied the section, and a hidden Downloads stayed hidden after a restart.
Fourteen other tests passed; tests 95 and 96 did not run, because the local run hit its time budget.
lines.say: Fourteen other tests passed; tests ninety-five and ninety-six did not run, because the local run hit its time budget.

lines.caption: Recent, editing bookmarks, and watching the folders file for changes were not tested.
Retested after the fixes, the test passed in 42 seconds, and a Pictures folder set to home was left out.
lines.say: Retested after the fixes, the test passed in forty-two seconds, and a Pictures folder set to home was left out.

lines.caption: Hiding Downloads in Places stored only its places entry, and after a restart Downloads showed once, as a bookmark.
CI's verify and its screenshot audit passed on an earlier fix commit; the run on the latest commit was still going.
Before the first push, a local review at high found eight issues; six were fixed and two kept.
The fixes show the header for the first bookmark, update every row for a folder, and skip a duplicate Desktop.
Skipped: a bookmarked standard folder also shows in Bookmarks, as the issue asks, and the group comments stay.
CI then reviewed each code push; its 23 findings are in the code review comment.
lines.say: CI then reviewed each code push; its twenty-three findings are in the code review comment.

lines.caption: The first review's findings were fixed here, and CI's own fix commit fixed the next six.
The owner chose to hide standard folders apart from bookmarks, and CI fixed three more findings after that.
Six findings were accepted: three by the owner, and three low ones, such as a device icon issue older than this PR.
After the merge, check that Downloads and Videos open your drive's folders, and try editing a bookmark.
Part 3. Nothing depends on issue 17, so only a cleanup of your bookmarks file remains.
lines.say: Part 3. Nothing depends on issue seventeen, so only a cleanup of your bookmarks file remains.

lines.caption: After the merge, delete the four folder bookmarks and the fake divider from your bookmarks file.
In short: standard folders now live in Places, and bookmarks get a section of their own.
